edits.after: People do not have to believe a company will never make mistakes in order to work there. Any collective decision may be incomplete and may ultimately prove wrong. People are often willing to carry out a plan they do not entirely agree with because they trust that their judgment will not merely be given a show of attention, that the decision-maker will not disappear after failure, and that the organization will not arbitrarily rewrite responsibility to protect a particular position.
edits.reason: Replace convoluted negatives and 'pretended to have been heard' with natural prose; preserve all three grounds of trust and the admission of imperfect decisions.
edits.before: People are not willing to work in a company only when certain it will never make mistakes. Any collective decision may be incomplete and may ultimately prove wrong. People are often willing to implement a plan they do not entirely endorse because they believe their judgment will not merely be pretended to have been heard, the decision-maker will not disappear after failure, and the institution will not arbitrarily rewrite responsibility to protect a particular position.

edits.after: Managers cannot treat every warning as obstruction, then demand that everyone “trust the decision” when it is time to carry it out. Nor can a company praise independent judgment as taking responsibility when it succeeds, then accuse the person of going beyond their authority for the same judgment when it fails.
edits.reason: Clarify the asymmetric labeling of initiative; preserve warnings, compliance and the identical judgment assessed differently by outcome.
edits.before: Managers cannot treat every warning as obstruction while demanding that everyone “trust the decision” when implementation is needed. Nor can a company call independent judgment responsibility when it succeeds, then call the same judgment an overstepping of authority when it fails.

edits.after: Trust grows from a pattern people can recognize time and again: those who decide explain their decisions; those who carry them out answer for carrying them out; those who change the conditions acknowledge that the conditions have changed.
edits.reason: Naturalize the repeated-order concept without removing any of its three responsibility assignments.
edits.before: Trust comes from an order that can be recognized repeatedly: those who decide explain; those who implement answer for implementation; those who change the conditions acknowledge that the conditions have changed.

edits.after: This is not necessarily because people have become lazy. It may be because the organization holds them responsible for outcomes without truly taking on the risks they face when they exercise judgment.
edits.reason: 'Bear results' is not idiomatic; retain the qualification and the mismatch between imposed responsibility and supported risk.
edits.before: This is not necessarily because people have become lazy. It may be because the organization demands that they bear results without ever genuinely accepting the risks they must face in exercising judgment.

edits.after: An organization that uses procedure only to avoid responsibility may look impeccably orderly while growing increasingly hollow inside.
edits.reason: The source means outward procedural propriety, not necessarily external legal regulation as 'highly regulated' suggests.
edits.before: An organization that relies solely on procedure to avoid responsibility may appear highly regulated while becoming increasingly hollow inside.

edits.after: Good systems must do more than prevent misplaced blame. They must also give people the confidence to make judgments that can produce something new.
edits.reason: Render the institutional conditions for responsible initiative in ordinary language without deleting the innovation side of the argument.
edits.before: Good institutions must not only prevent misplaced blame. They must also allow people to dare to make judgments capable of producing new results.

edits.after: De lo contrario, la confianza más valiosa de la organización se utiliza para desplazar la responsabilidad hacia quienes resulta más fácil obligar a cargar con ella.
edits.reason: Clarify easiest to burden rather than greatest natural capacity to bear costs; matches the English and responsibility-shifting context.
edits.before: De lo contrario, la confianza más valiosa se utiliza para desplazar la responsabilidad hacia quienes más fácilmente pueden cargar con ella.

edits.after: Quien ejecuta responde por ejecutar y quien decide por decidir. La responsabilidad por los aspectos en los que ambas partes influyen puede compartirse, pero que el resultado pase finalmente por unas manos no permite descargar sobre ellas toda la cadena de decisiones.
edits.reason: Repair the ungrammatical 'Lo que ambas partes influyen' and retain the complete distinction between shared influence and dumping the whole decision chain on the last implementer.
edits.before: Quien ejecuta responde por ejecutar y quien decide por decidir. Lo que ambas partes influyen puede compartirse, pero que el resultado pase finalmente por unas manos no permite descargar sobre ellas toda la cadena de decisiones.

edits.after: Likewise, someone who makes a mistaken choice within the part of the work they control must answer for that part. They cannot shift responsibility upward for negligence they could have avoided simply because someone else set the direction.
edits.reason: Replace the literal 'hand back avoidable negligence along with the direction' while preserving implementers' own responsibility.
edits.before: Likewise, implementers who make mistaken choices within their own remit must bear that part of responsibility. They cannot hand back avoidable negligence along with the direction merely because the direction came from above.

edits.after: Someone who refuses additional resources, insists on the original deadline, and demands the same result has already helped decide how those below will have to bear the pressure. The people doing the work may choose the specific overtime, compromises, or risks. But constraints imposed from above cannot then be treated as though they were simply facts of nature.
edits.reason: Make the conditions-versus-natural-background argument readable while retaining all three constraints and the executor's choices.
edits.before: Someone who refuses additional resources, insists on the original deadline, and demands unchanged results has already helped decide how those below must bear pressure. Even if implementers choose the specific overtime, compromises, or risks, the conditions closed off from above cannot be treated as a natural backdrop.

edits.after: On the contrary, it makes authority easier to accept. People know when they must comply, and also know that compliance does not mean taking over responsibility for every judgment made by the decision-maker. They can concentrate on doing the work well rather than continually guessing how responsibility will later be rewritten.
edits.reason: Clarify 'bearing every judgment on the decision-maker's behalf' without weakening the distinction between authority and accountability.
edits.before: On the contrary, it makes authority easier to accept. People know when they must comply, and also know that compliance does not mean bearing every judgment on the decision-maker's behalf. They can concentrate on doing the work well rather than continually guessing how responsibility will later be rewritten.

edits.after: Quien ejecuta un plan sobre el que no tuvo la última palabra quizá no lo comparte plenamente: puede confiar en que quien decide dispone de más información y reconocerá como propia la decisión si las cosas salen mal. Ceder parte de la capacidad de decidir no debería producir solo una acción más unificada, sino también que alguien responda por la dirección de esa acción común.
edits.reason: Make explicit that the decision-maker acknowledges the decision as their own, rather than the ambiguous 'reconocerá su juicio'. Preserve fuller information and reciprocal responsibility.
edits.before: Quien ejecuta un plan sobre el que no tuvo la última palabra quizá no lo comparte plenamente: puede confiar en que quien decide sabe más y reconocerá su juicio cuando salga mal. Ceder parte de la decisión no debería producir solo una acción más unificada, sino también que alguien responda por la dirección de esa unidad.

edits.after: Quien se niega a ampliar recursos, mantiene el plazo y exige que el resultado no se vea afectado ya participa en decidir cómo soportarán la presión los demás. Aunque las horas extra, las renuncias o los riesgos concretos los elija quien ejecuta, no se puede presentar como algo inevitable lo que se decidió dejar cerrado desde arriba.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'un fondo natural' with the intended contrast between imposed choices and seemingly inevitable background conditions.
edits.before: Quien se niega a ampliar recursos, mantiene el plazo y exige que el resultado no se vea afectado ya participa en decidir cómo soportarán la presión los demás. Aunque las horas extra, las renuncias o los riesgos concretos los elija quien ejecuta, las condiciones cerradas desde arriba no pueden tratarse como un fondo natural.

edits.after: Second, deciding together requires access to the facts.
edits.reason: State the information-access requirement naturally; the next paragraph preserves the unequal-information example and its limits.
edits.before: Second, shared decisions require genuine information.

edits.after: Nor does it mistake this for personal dictatorship. Someone with final authority can still listen seriously, accept constraints, and correct mistakes. Identifying the decision-maker actually makes participation more genuine: vague language can no longer hold others responsible for decisions they had no power to make.
edits.reason: Clarify the source's metonymic 'bear powers they never possessed' as accountability without authority, not possession of powers.
edits.before: Nor does it understand this as personal dictatorship. Someone with final authority can still listen seriously, accept constraints, and correct mistakes. A clear decision-maker actually makes participation more genuine, because others need not bear, through vague language, powers they never possessed.

edits.after: “We are all working for the same thing” can make people willing to cooperate, but cannot prove that every trade-off was made jointly. People may share a goal while judging methods, risks, and costs differently. The more sincerely everyone is committed, the more these differences must remain visible, so that a deep sense of belonging does not become a way of spreading the accountability of those in power across everyone else.
edits.reason: Make the final power-accountability relationship explicit in ordinary language while preserving mission, different judgments and sincere belonging.
edits.before: “We are all working for the same thing” can make people willing to cooperate, but cannot prove that every trade-off was made jointly. People may share a goal while judging methods, risks, and costs differently. The more sincerely everyone is committed, the more these differences must remain visible, lest the deepest belonging be used instead to diffuse the responsibility of power.

edits.after: A genuine team decision is not made genuine by including everyone in the same sentence. What matters is being able to explain what each person was entitled to do, what information they had, and how much influence they could exert during the process.
edits.reason: Replace abstract 'standing' with concrete participation rights while retaining all three criteria.
edits.before: A genuine team decision is genuine not because everyone is included in the same sentence, but because each person's standing, information, and influence in the process can be explained.

edits.after: Admitting that does not make the team any less of a team.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'does not deprive a team of its shared character' without denying the possibility of a single final decision-maker.
edits.before: The latter does not deprive a team of its shared character.

edits.after: It simply refuses to let “teamwork” hide who holds the power.
edits.reason: Keep the force of the closing invisibility metaphor in idiomatic English.
edits.before: It simply refuses to use that shared character to make power invisible.

edits.after: Tampoco lo confunde con una dictadura personal. Tener la última palabra es compatible con escuchar seriamente, aceptar límites y corregir errores. Identificar claramente a quien decide hace más real la participación: el lenguaje ambiguo ya no permite responsabilizar a los demás de decisiones que no tenían poder para tomar.
edits.reason: Clarify accountability for decisions without power, rather than the literal 'asumir un poder que nunca tuvieron'.
edits.before: Tampoco lo confunde con una dictadura personal. Tener la última palabra es compatible con escuchar seriamente, aceptar límites y corregir errores. Identificar claramente a quien decide hace más real la participación: los demás no tienen que asumir, mediante lenguaje ambiguo, un poder que nunca tuvieron.

edits.after: On the contrary, it means setting aside labels about the speaker's emotions and examining what they actually said, together.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'takes their words out of emotional labels' and retain shared scrutiny rather than exemption from it.
edits.before: On the contrary, it takes their words out of emotional labels and places them where they can be examined together.

edits.after: Innovation needs this kind of room, too.
edits.reason: Replace the dangling comparison 'bears the same relationship to innovation' with its clear practical meaning.
edits.before: Such room bears the same relationship to innovation.

edits.after: People place real trust in an organization when they bring uncertain judgments into the work they share. The organization honors that trust by not leaving the person who offers an unfinished judgment to carry its risks alone.
edits.reason: Avoid technical-sounding 'entrustment' and 'receiving trust'; preserve both the member's exposure of uncertain judgment and the organization's reciprocal risk-bearing.
edits.before: Genuine entrustment is members' willingness to bring uncertain judgments into shared work. Genuinely receiving that trust means the organization does not leave every unfinished judgment as a personal risk for its proposer alone.

edits.after: This route is not just there to make people feel respected.
edits.reason: Replace the awkward 'exists for more than making' without changing the practical accountability function explained next.
edits.before: This path exists for more than making members feel respected.

edits.after: Letting an opinion count means it can enter the decision-making process without first being reshaped into something the listener already agrees with.
edits.reason: Naturalize the eligibility metaphor while preserving that agreement is not a precondition for consideration.
edits.before: Letting an opinion count means your words do not first have to become something the other person agrees with before they qualify to enter the decision.

edits.after: But it cannot ask people to use their judgment, then accept their cooperation only once that judgment has been stripped away.
edits.reason: Preserve the closing contrast in more direct, readable English.
edits.before: But it cannot demand that members bring judgment while accepting only cooperation from which judgment has already disappeared.

edits.after: ¿Es una cuestión de hechos o de sopesar valores distintos? ¿Qué información ha visto quien habla? ¿Qué riesgo se asume al no aceptar su propuesta? ¿Quién decide finalmente y por qué?
edits.reason: Restore the trade-off between values, not merely a generic facts-versus-values distinction.
edits.before: ¿Es una cuestión de hechos o de valores? ¿Qué información ha visto quien habla? ¿Qué riesgo se asume al no aceptar su propuesta? ¿Quién decide finalmente y por qué?

edits.after: La innovación también necesita ese margen.
edits.reason: Replace the vague 'tiene la misma relación con la innovación' with natural language while preserving the shared need for room for unfinished ideas.
edits.before: Ese espacio tiene la misma relación con la innovación.

edits.after: Los miembros confían de verdad algo a la organización cuando aportan juicios inciertos al trabajo común. La organización responde a esa confianza cuando no deja todo el riesgo de cada juicio inmaduro en manos de quien lo propone.
edits.reason: Express the two-sided act of entrusting and receiving rather than collapse it into generic confidence; preserve uncertain judgments and individual risk.
edits.before: La confianza real consiste en ofrecer juicios inciertos al trabajo común; recibirla de verdad consiste en no dejar cada juicio inmaduro como un riesgo exclusivamente personal de quien lo propuso.

edits.after: They have accepted shared arrangements and acknowledged that, within certain areas, someone in a particular role has the final say. As long as a decision stays within the legitimate scope of those arrangements, having one's own view rejected does not make shared work an agreement that counts only when one agrees.
edits.reason: Untangle the final sentence while retaining legitimate scope, delegated final authority and the objection to making cooperation conditional on personal agreement.
edits.before: They have accepted shared arrangements and acknowledged that, within certain areas, final judgment belongs to a particular position. As long as a decision remains within the legitimate scope of those arrangements, members cannot treat shared work as an agreement valid only when they agree simply because their own opinion was not adopted.

edits.after: People carry things out not because they accept a shared order, but because refusal costs too much. Such an organization may still get everyone to act in line, but it will struggle to earn the trust people give freely rather than under pressure.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'obtain genuine trust placed in it'; preserve coercive cost versus freely entrusted cooperation.
edits.before: People carry things out not because they acknowledge a shared order, but because refusal costs too much. Such an organization may still obtain orderly action, but will struggle to obtain genuine trust placed in it.

edits.after: Members know they need not first give up their judgment to belong, and that a shared direction does not require everyone to become the same person. When they genuinely agree with a decision, that agreement then carries weight: it is not just the look of agreement everyone is expected to wear with the job.
edits.reason: Keep the source's standard-expression metaphor without the obscure 'expression supplied with the job'; retain judgment and nonuniformity.
edits.before: Members know they need not first cancel their judgment to belong, and that a shared direction does not require everyone to become the same person. When they genuinely agree with a decision, that agreement then carries weight, instead of being the standard expression supplied with the job.

edits.after: Quien entra acepta una serie de acuerdos comunes y reconoce que, en ciertos ámbitos, la decisión final corresponde a determinados cargos. Mientras la decisión se mantenga dentro de los límites legítimos de ese acuerdo, que no se haya aceptado la opinión propia no permite tratar el trabajo común como si solo valiera cuando uno está de acuerdo.
edits.reason: Untangle the causal and conditional clauses while preserving all source qualifications.
edits.before: Se ha aceptado un acuerdo común y reconocido que, en determinados ámbitos, el juicio final corresponde a ciertas posiciones. Mientras la decisión esté dentro de ese ámbito legítimo, no puede tratarse el trabajo común como un acuerdo válido solo cuando uno está de acuerdo porque no se aceptó su opinión.

edits.after: Pero ejecutar una decisión y estar de acuerdo con ella siguen siendo cosas distintas.
edits.reason: Clarify 'compartir' as agreement with a decision, not sharing an object.
edits.before: Pero ejecutar y compartir siguen siendo cosas distintas.

edits.after: En el trabajo cotidiano, la mayoría de los desacuerdos no llega tan lejos.
edits.reason: Repair the unidiomatic 'En la mayoría del trabajo cotidiano' without changing the limited claim.
edits.before: En la mayoría del trabajo cotidiano, las diferencias no llegan tan lejos.

edits.after: Los miembros saben que no deben anular su criterio para formar parte y que una dirección común no exige convertirse todos en la misma persona. Cuando realmente comparten una decisión, ese acuerdo tiene peso: no es la expresión estándar que viene con el puesto.
edits.reason: Use natural 'anular su criterio' rather than literal 'cancelar', consistent with the earlier essay's independent-judgment language.
edits.before: Los miembros saben que no deben cancelar su criterio para formar parte y que una dirección común no exige convertirse todos en la misma persona. Cuando realmente comparten una decisión, ese acuerdo tiene peso: no es la expresión estándar que viene con el puesto.

review_scope.reading_basis: Read every paragraph of the formal ZIP Chinese, English and Spanish manuscripts for work06–10 and their titles. Total825 body-paragraph readings. Used bounded outputs; EP06 English paragraphs35–45 were retrieved separately to recover the segment truncated in the first output, including40–42. No remaining unread body paragraphs.
review_scope.semantic_review: Full argument/example/qualification comparison, not merely paragraph counts. Incoming English and Spanish are full-length. Preserved all roles and reciprocal responsibility; execution versus direction; actual options versus shared participation; dissent versus sabotage; and legitimate-scope/serious-refusal qualifications. Changes are localized language repairs and clarification of metaphors, not condensation or added external facts. No source-level change found necessary.
review_scope.metadata: Five English titles remove numeric prefixes and are naturalized where needed; two Spanish titles polished. Remaining Spanish titles already have no numeric prefix and are natural.
review_scope.limits: Normative editorial and fidelity review, not independent legal, medical or empirical factchecking. No translation service. Did not execute supplied HTML scripts or edit ZIP/repo, commit, integrate or publish.
